comment: Country / regional examples: No inaccuracies noted. Observation: No mention was made of regional networks such as Asia eHealth Information Network and multilaterals such as ASEAN and SPC, all of which enrich the experience of their member countries and can serve as effective vehicles for collaboration and knowledge sharing. Not mentioning these regional networks and their role in strengthening standards adoption as a group will be a big missed opportunity.
